headline: Aerospace and Industrial margins surge on price and volume
summary_short: Woodward posted Q3 FY2026 revenue of $1,109.7M (+21.2% y/y) and diluted EPS of $2.40 (+36.4% y/y), as Aerospace segment earnings jumped 35.2% y/y and Industrial segment earnings surged 85.8% y/y on higher volumes and price realization.
summary_long: Aerospace net sales rose 18.9% y/y to $708.7M and segment earnings rose 35.2% to $170.0M (24.0% margin, from 21.1%) on higher volumes and price realization, including a one-time retroactive pricing adjustment, partly offset by inflation and unfavorable mix. Industrial net sales rose 25.5% y/y to $401.0M and segment earnings rose 85.8% to $88.5M (22.1% margin, from 14.9%) on volume leverage and pricing, partly offset by inflation. Consolidated gross margin expanded to 31.5% from 27.2%. Net debt borrowings of $644.6M YTD funded the $120.7M Valve Research acquisition and $553.0M of YTD buybacks ($198.1M in the quarter); cash fell to $474.9M. No explicit numeric guidance was given for Q4.
